subject.title: feat(workboard): identify active cards in user-visible replies

question: Should active Workboard-card identification be a supported user-visible feature, and if so should it remain fully plugin-owned rather than extend the core reply-payload contract?
rationale: The patch introduces a new visible output convention and a Workboard-specific core field; choosing a durable cross-plugin contract versus a plugin-local implementation requires maintainer product and API intent.

options.title: Keep the feature plugin-owned
options.body: Refactor the strict-format bypass and marker behavior behind a plugin/runtime seam without adding a Workboard field to `ReplyPayload`.

options.title: Adopt a generic extension contract
options.body: Approve and design a documented plugin-neutral reply-metadata contract first, then migrate this feature to that contract.

options.title: Defer the marker feature
options.body: Land only the independently useful dashboard agent-routing repair if it is validated separately, and defer user-visible Workboard markers.

recommendation.title: Keep the feature plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Refactor the strict-format bypass and marker behavior behind a plugin/runtime seam without adding a Workboard field to `ReplyPayload`.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidenced contributor connected to all changed Workboard and routing paths; maintainer ownership history requires a follow-up repository-history check.
